source.document: Specification (from 2017) — Cambridge IGCSE Media Studies 0473 is no longer published, so the Eduqas GCSE specification is used instead
source.track: GCSE (9–1) · England · ages 14–16 · Component 1 (40%), Component 2 (30%), Component 3 non-exam assessment (30%)

note: Units follow the specification's three components in teaching order, opening with the theoretical framework (media language, representation, media industries, audiences) and media contexts through which Component 1 introduces the subject. The framework and contexts map to foundational lessons; the Component 1 sections and in-depth form studies feed the intermediate lessons; the music topic and Component 3 production carry the advanced and expert lessons.
